metrics.summary: Root cause: `_set_path` in appcfg/loader.py used `node = node[k]` for intermediate keys, raising `KeyError: 'cache'` when an APP__ env var (APP__CACHE__REDIS__URL in staging) targeted a section not present in DEFAULTS or the config file. Fix: intermediate segments now use `node.get(k)` and create a new dict when the segment is missing (or not a dict), so env overrides can create arbitrary-depth sections/keys. Coercion still uses the existing value's type via `_coerce(raw, node.get(leaf))`, so new keys stay strings; `load` still works on a `deepcopy(DEFAULTS)`, leaving DEFAULTS untouched. Verified with the existing 4 tests (all pass) and a reproduction of the exact staging env: cache.redis.url is created as a string, db.pool.size coerced to int 20, http.debug to bool False, and DEFAULTS unchanged.
